items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: Buddy Petey was a good musician. Real good musician.

ctx.x: Did most of the guys you played with read music?
All of those guys in Tuts Johnson's band read music. Yeah. Buddy Petey was a good musician. Real good musician.
Would you say as long as that sounds better than you heard?
